Title: City Selection screen displays popular cities, scrollable full list, search bar, and "Tap to share location" CTA
Expected Result: All four elements render

Title: Selecting a city with no sub-cities saves it and updates Home content
Steps: Select a city where hasSubCities:false (e.g. Bangalore)
Expected Result: City saved, Home/other screens reflect new city

Title: Selecting a city with sub-cities opens a sub-dropdown
Expected Result: Sub-dropdown appears listing its sub-cities

Title: Selecting a sub-city saves city + sub-city and updates content
Expected Result: Both city and sub-city persisted; content updates for Gurgaon

Title: Selecting "All" under a sub-city dropdown selects the parent city
Steps: Select Delhi-NCR then choose "All" in sub-city dropdown
Expected Result: "Delhi-NCR" is saved as the selected city

Title: Search returns matching cities/sub-cities for a valid keyword
Expected Result: Results include Delhi and Delhi NCR

Title: Search is case-insensitive and supports partial matches
Expected Result: Identical result sets both times

Title: Search resolves alias names
Expected Result: Result shows "Gurugram"

Title: Voice search returns matching results
Steps: Grant mic permission, speak a city name
Expected Result: Speech converted to text, matching city results shown

Title: "Tap to share location" fetches location automatically
Expected Result: Location fetch flow triggers (per UC 8)

Title: Popular cities render in Admin-configured sequence with name and image
Expected Result: Popular cities ordered per configured sequenceNumber, each showing name + image

Title: Full city/sub-city list renders alphabetically A-Z
Expected Result: Entries sorted alphabetically

Title: Closing without selecting retains the previously saved city
Steps: With a city already saved, open City Selection, close without choosing
Expected Result: Previous city remains active

Title: Searching a city not in the list shows "City not found"
Expected Result: "City not found" message; existing list remains selectable

Title: Search does not trigger below the 2-character minimum
Expected Result: No search triggered/no results fetched

Title: Search rejects disallowed characters
Expected Result: Input rejected or yields no results, no crash

Title: Search input with leading/trailing spaces still matches correctly
Expected Result: Same results as trimmed "Delhi"

Title: Denied microphone permission shows Settings/Cancel prompt
Steps: Deny mic permission, tap mic icon
Expected Result: Popup shown with Settings/Cancel; Cancel falls back to text search

Title: City list load failure shows an error message
Steps: Simulate network/server failure while loading city list
Expected Result: Error message shown instead of blank screen

Title: Missing popular-city image shows a generic placeholder
Steps: Popular city configured without an image
Expected Result: Generic placeholder image displayed

Title: GET /api/get-city-list success renders Popular Cities and full city list matching payload
Expected Result: statusCode:200, message:"en.CITY_LISTED"; UI Popular Cities == data.popularCities[], full list == data.cities[] by cityName/cityId

Title: Sub-city dropdown matches subCities[] for cities with hasSubCities:true
Expected Result: Dropdown options equal each entry's CityName from the API's subCities[] array

Title: Popular cities render ordered by ascending sequenceNumber
Steps: Inspect API response sequenceNumber per popular city vs rendered order
Expected Result: UI order matches ascending sequenceNumber (Mumbai-All=3, Bangalore=5, Delhi-NCR=19, Hyderabad=22, Chennai=27)

Title: Non-200/error response from get-city-list surfaces an error state
Steps: Mock a non-200 response or timeout on get-city-list
Expected Result: UI shows an error message, no blank/broken screen

Title: Empty cities[] in API payload renders an empty state without crashing
Steps: Mock data.cities:[] while popularCities still has entries
Expected Result: Full-list section shows an empty state; Popular Cities still renders

Title: Both Guest and Logged-in users can fully use City Selection
Steps: Repeat CTY-002 as Guest, then as a logged-in user
Expected Result: Identical behavior for both actor types (per PRD Primary Actor)
